_doc: Owner-approved, time-limited exceptions to the blocking CI dependency audit (.github/workflows/ci.yml, scripts/audit-exceptions.mjs). Each entry covers ONE advisory in ONE directory until its expiry date; any other high/critical advisory, the same advisory elsewhere, or an expired entry fails CI.

exceptions.reason: picomatch ReDoS (affects <=4.0.7; 4.0.7 is the latest release, no patched version exists). Present only in this dev-only test fixture's build toolchain (vite -> tinyglobby -> fdir/picomatch); the fixture is built by the weekly design-locked builder e2e and never deployed. Downgrading vite introduces other high advisories (GHSA-93m4-6634-74q7, GHSA-fx2h-pf6j-xcff). Remove this entry once picomatch publishes a fix.
